details: MetaMask announced a security incident on September 30, 2026, leading to precautionary exits of affected Ethereum validators in its non-custodial staking service. While no immediate threat to user wallets was stated, withdrawals could take up to 45 days, highlighting infrastructure vulnerabilities within the staking ecosystem.
title: MetaMask Exits Validators After Security Incident

details: Ethereum's price rallied above $2,700 on September 30, 2026, following softer-than-expected U.S. PCE inflation data, which reduced perceived odds of a Fed rate hike. This contributed to ETH recording its highest monthly close of 2026 and its best third quarter in history.
title: Ethereum Eyes $2,800 Amid Softer Inflation Data

details: Citi has issued new 12-month price targets, forecasting Bitcoin (BTC) to reach $181,000 and Ether (ETH) to hit $5,400. This outlook suggests a modest upside for both major cryptocurrencies in the coming year, reflecting an institutional perspective on market potential.
title: Citi Updates BTC, ETH Price Forecasts for 2027

details: A report by staff for US Senator Richard Blumenthal (D-CT) claims that 84% of 846 cryptocurrency wallets sanctioned or targeted for seizure due to links with Iran primarily transacted in Tether's USDT stablecoin. This highlights increasing regulatory scrutiny on stablecoin usage for illicit activities.
title: US Senator Flags Tether (USDT) for Iranian Sanctions Evasion

details: XRP recorded a 37% gain over the past 90 days, slightly outperforming Bitcoin's 36% increase. However, it still trades 59% below its all-time high of $3.65 reached in July 2025, with analysts suggesting substantial new capital (around $136 billion) is needed for a full recovery amidst rising Treasury yields.
title: XRP Surpasses Bitcoin in 90-Day Gains But Remains Far Off All-Time High
